notes: Craft: the enclosure scene uses a square→ring sequence to stage opening-and-return; the Daphne scene keeps both the ring (tree) and the two powers at its edges, refusing a blend. Gebser paraphrase boundaries (no exact quotation) respected. E0 acceptance repair: title/field collision fixed on m-apd-0-view, m-apd-1-confidence, m-apd-3-daphne, m-apd-4-diaphaneity, m-apd-5-return (title width 560; formations iteratively scaled and dropped clear of the title band); cover re-captured.

#0 view — the sight-line triangle walks from beside the world-disc toward the ring's edge, inside the held image's frame (the situated line of sight acquiring its position); gentle attract field; a slow turbulence LFO breathes the world before the view (auto-drift). Critic fix 2026-10-06: the return now stages the triangle the note claims (grounded in the record's 'definite image can again be offered'); the #0 description corrected — the sight-line sits inside the ring; body columns nudged (y 0.60, narrower) clear of the formation mass.

#1 confidence — grid layout (Gebser's sector claiming exclusive validity); the enclosure square grows; the unmarked remainder is pushed to the frame's edge and marked x — the measure's own act of counting what escapes it as deficient; the absent Father (∅) stands inside the enclosure; field turns inward (circulation −0.4); pointer repel/shove — the view discounts the witness.

#2 Dionysus — the bounded disc dismembers (❋) and reconstitutes as a ring: what dies is the form's claim to stand complete; what returns must acquire a form; field turbulence 0.4, dispersion 0.2, vortex pointer — the maenadic opening; ϴ (the opened circle) brightens at the rim.

#3 Daphne — Daphne carries a repel field (the other who cannot be absorbed); her own boundary-ring deepens green and tightens around her under both powers' pull (A and ϴ hold attract at the edges — drawn, not merging); pointer repel/pulse — respect of the other's edge; no Ovidian pursuit is staged (her separate whole is declared, not restaged).

#4 diaphaneity — THE 3D SCENE. z is the opening of 180° into 360°: the perspectival triangle stays deep (z −0.35), the contextual ring expands at z 0, the ∴ of counter-positions stands nearest (z +0.3), care ❤ and the knower's ◉ hold intermediate depths — the knower has a position within the field, not above it; depth perspective + occlusion with a cold depth tint; contextual ring sequence 180°-small → 360°-full; circulation LFO breathes the field (auto-context); pointer attract/implode — the context gathers without erasing.

#5→0 return — the definite image offered again: a triangle (e147) stands inside the relation ring beside the renewed seeing ◉, A20/A21 and the ↺ of contextual return — the record's own return, 'Apollo returns to articulation. A definite image can again be offered to another'; attract strength halved against #0 (0.35 vs 0.7) — offering without grasping. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's sight-line walked inside the gold ring toward its edge (a view forming); #5→0 sets the triangle at rest within the same ring — the act of seeing re-formed inside the relation it had only begun to hold, Daphne's green ◉ remnant at the rim; the field that opened gathering (attract 0.7) closes offering (attract 0.35).

Human-amplified staging (frontmatter: all three relations yes): the alterity check, mutual answerability and contextual return are Taylor's authored programme — the scene bodies carry the landings (A20, Mv 35, Draft 3) and the record-scope guards (no Ovidian restaging; Dionysus not in Ovid's cast). Mythemic verbs only: Daphne proves-discloses the alterity difference; no formal entailment, no historical attribution.

Automation: auto-drift (turbulence, the world before the view) and auto-context (circulation, the contextual field's breath) — tied to the record's moves. Durations 11–15, transitions 1.2–2.2: the diaphaneity scene held longest. glyph_rationales.∅: the absent Father: the missing ground invoked as ultimate warrant — lack numbed into a surrogate presence that exempts the view's own position from the order it imposes (#1).
glyph_rationales.·: the unnamed carrier — a formation whose sense is its shape alone (world-disc, enclosure, held image, ring of relation); no glyph is pretended.
glyph_rationales.◉: the marked remainder: what escapes the measure, counted deficient by the confident view (#1); at #5→0 it re-reads as the remnant of the other the form still carries.
glyph_rationales.ϴ: Dionysus — the circle opened at its crown: release through which the enclosed view meets its conditions again, returning through form (#2).
glyph_rationales.♪: Nietzsche's musical office: music's overwhelming universality mediated to the hearer by tragic myth (Birth of Tragedy §21).
glyph_rationales.❋: the dismemberment: the form's claim to stand complete in itself dying, so life can return through reconstitution (#2, Taylor's authored sequence).
glyph_rationales.Daphne: the particular centre whose existence exceeds what either power makes of her — the alterity check on appropriation by determination and by undifferentiation (#3).
glyph_rationales.A: Apollo: the communicable boundary — articulation that lets a difference hold long enough to be shared and revisited (#0–#1).
glyph_rationales.x: the finite particular marked deficient by the confident measure (Taylor's X/x: the manifest circumstance whose determining depth the view cannot name) — discounted at #1, restored within the contextual field at #4.
glyph_rationales.∴: positions, counter-positions and their transitions available together — the 360° contextual field into which the perspectival triangle opens (#4).
glyph_rationales.❤: care and telos: the embodied concern giving transparency its lived direction — equanimity requires acknowledging concern (Taylor's P5).
glyph_rationales.A20: image, valuation, possession: the transition where the image's valuation governs what its source is allowed to be (#1, answered at #5→0).
glyph_rationales.A21: individuation and recognition: the other received through the continuing capacity to respond (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.↺: the contextual return: form coming back with its source still able to answer (#5→0).
